Munadi Project
Munadi is a simple yet powerful athan app designed to be a companion in your daily life. It offers a clean, beautiful interface free from advertisements and tracking, delivering precise prayer alerts for any city worldwide. The app includes dual calendar support (Gregorian and Hijri), multiple calculation methods, and the ability to view prayer schedules for any date—past or future. A range of thoughtful settings allows you to tailor the experience to your personal needs.
Features:
Prayer times for nearly any city around the globe
Lightweight design with no advertisements or tracking
Countdown to the next prayer, visible in tooltips
View prayer times for past or future dates
Automatic switching between Dark and Light themes
Customizable UI visual effects
Dynamic wallpapers that reflect the time of prayer
Convenient system-tray support
Flexible time format options
Individual control to enable, mute, or adjust athan volumes
Option to assign a unique athan for each prayer
Fine-tune prayer times and Hijri date offsets
Support for various global calculation methods

This release brings some nice UI enhancements and backend improvements to the app. Few itchy bugs were also squashed. Notable Bug Fixes
Fix tooltip time-left string doesn't handle time jumps
Fix custom audio list becoming stale if was configured for a prayer when a custom audio is removed randomly
Monochrome tray icon now correctly tracks dark/light theme switches
Improvements
**New Icon**: Munadi now uses a new material-gradient inspired icon derived from Masjid Al-Aqsa
Use the accent color derived from icon throughout
Improve keyboard navigations throughout the app
Improve UI geometry adjustment behaviors
Use a thinner font stroke on prayer table
Right align prayer times on the table
Replace "+" and "-" buttons beside the speaker icon with "Add" and "Remove" texts
Add a "Video" category option in file dialog to let users add video files as audio files too which is supported natively
Few code restructures
Lazy-load/save config and make settings changes atomic
New file manager backend for improved, robust and stateless store management, improving experience inside sandboxes (e.g. flatpaks, snap)
Upgrade to Qt 6.11.1
Bring back Arabic support
Misc
Drop $XDG_MUSIC_HOME permission on flatpak since it's not needed anymore

The self-extracting installer
Munadi can now be installed using a self-extracting installer. No need for downloading loads of dependencies, just make it executable (chmod +x) and run the interactive installer. That's it! If you want to try it out, the latest version of the installer is available at https://gitlab.com/munadi/munadi/-/releases/.
